product_metadata.title: Klear Vu Omega Non-Slip Rocking Chair Cushion Set with Thick Padding and Tufted Design, Includes Seat Pad & Back Pillow with Ties for Living Room Rocker, 17x17 Inches, 2 Piece Set, Blue
features: NON-SLIP GRIPPER BOTTOM - Keep it in place; The seat cushion features our Signature Gripper Bottom, a furniture-safe and slip-resistant material, while the back cushion comes with ties to secure it
VERSATILE USE - Use the chair pads for your living room, home office, nursery, and even outside on your patio; However, remember to bring them back inside to ensure they remain in good condition
PREMIUM TOUCH - The rocking chair pads have durable yet soft fabric stuffed with our uniquely designed CloudFill that is bouncy, making chairs more enjoyable for extended sitting periods
RELIABLE DESIGN - The indoor rocking chair cushions measure 17"L x 17"W x 3"H for the seat and 21"L x 17"W x 3"H for the seat back; Includes (1) seat pad and (1) backrest pad; Chairs are not included
FILLED AND FINISHED IN THE U.S.A - These cushions for rocking chairs are made from Global/USA Materials and manufactured in the USA; Made of 64% Polyester / 31% Cotton / 5% Viscose; Spot clean only
description: Transform your rocking chair into a stylish and comfy piece of furniture with Klear Vu’s Rocking Chair Cushion set. The rocker chair cushions include (1) seat pad and (1) backrest pad. Ideal for your wooden rocking chair, dining chair, and even for office use so you can stay comfortable for an extended period. The Rocking chair seat cushion measures 17"L x 17"W x 3"H while the backrest is 21"L x 17"W x 3"H. The Rocking chair cushion set from Klear Vu features a beautifully textured fabric with button tufts to complement the interior of your home. The seat cushion has our Signature Gripper that keeps it in place even without ties. Overstuffed with our uniquely designed CloudFill for a fuller, thicker cushion that is truly comfortable. Perfect for your home, nursery or office. Trusted for decades, Klear Vu has been the premier manufacturer of stylish and functional chair cushions and rocking chair cushion sets. The rocking chair cushion set is available in many beautiful colors to match your home décor. Shop Klear Vu’s Saturn Rocking Chair Cushion set now!
